description: This is a documentation file describing the HDMIOutput HAL interface, including its overview, functional capabilities, external references, system context, resource management, data flow, system states, capabilities, and advanced features. It provides comprehensive details on the interface specifications, required behavior, and capability profile for HDMI output management.

classes.name: Capabilities
classes.description: Describes the supported video formats, pixel formats, color spaces, HDR modes, HDCP versions, and other capabilities of an HDMI output port.

classes.name: HDCPStatus
classes.description: Enumeration representing HDCP authentication states, such as authenticated, unauthenticated, or error states.

classes.name: HDROutputMode
classes.description: Enumeration of available HDR output modes such as HDR10, HLG, or auto mode.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Retrieves the capabilities of a specific HDMI output resource, including supported formats, resolutions, HDR, and HDCP features.
